system.description: You blow a handful of silver dust into the wind over a village or fortress.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and no one feels any unease.
outcomes.success: Everyone in the village or fortress forgets one specific event from the last 24 hours. They feel a vague unease where the memory used to be.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and materials are lost.
outcomes.ruin: You forget the event too, and why you cast the ritual. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
